# Architecture Decision Records (ADR)

Index of all architecture decisions recorded for this project.

| ADR | Title | Status | Date |
|-----|-------|--------|------|
| — | No ADRs registered yet | — | — |

## How to create a new ADR

Use the `/create-documentation` prompt and select "ADR". The `software-engineer` agent will use the template from the `technical-documentation` skill (Section 2).

## Numbering

ADRs are numbered sequentially (001, 002, 003...) and never reused. If an ADR is superseded, it receives status "Superseded by ADR-XXX".

## Possible statuses

- **Proposed** — Proposed, still under discussion
- **Accepted** — Accepted and in effect
- **Deprecated** — No longer applicable (without replacement)
- **Superseded by ADR-XXX** — Replaced by a more recent decision
